subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They saw something that needed protection.”?
options: Changing the time can change the feeling of a place.
The right words can change how people treat the same place.
Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.
Shared words can guide people when they are taken seriously.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Changing the time can change the feeling of a place.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They saw something that needed protection. The right words can change how people treat the same place.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They saw something that needed protection. The right words can change how people treat the same place.」，答案為「The right words can change how people treat the same place.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The right words can change how people treat the same place.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
